answer: A vertex of per-task receipts records who did what, and the opal of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, published publicly on failure, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. What survives to the yarrow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
